summary: Druids are hybrid casters who shapeshift into bear, cat, moonkin and travel forms and heal, tank, deal damage over time or fight at range as needed. They wear leather armour and use Nature and Arcane magic as well as their forms.
talent_levels_note: A talent ability can be taken once you can reach its row: the first talent point comes at level 10 and each row needs 5 more points, so row N opens at level 10 + 5 × (N − 1). Talent rows are from wowforevertalent.com; the Forever tooltips of Feral Charge (20), Primal Bite (40) and Wild Growth (40) show the same levels.

changes: New talent abilities: Lacerate and Primal Bite (Feral Combat), Shifting Power (Cat Form, converts Mana to Energy) and Wild Growth (Restoration).
Insect Swarm is now a Balance talent (row 4), moved from Restoration.
Feral Charge is one talent spell for both forms: a charge in Bear Form and a leap behind the target in Cat Form.
Revive is a new druid spell that resurrects a dead player out of combat.
Poised is a new passive learned at level 32 (reduces the cost of an Energy ability when used out of combat at full Energy); passives are not listed here.
Wowforevertalent.com marks Barkskin, Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, Moonkin Form and many damage/healing spells as changed; see the tooltip text for current values.
Omen of Clarity and Nature's Grasp are available as trained spells (levels 20 and 10).
conflicts: wowforevertalent.com's spellbook list does not include Tiger's Fury, but the Forever tooltip exists (level 24, Cat Form), so it is listed.
wowforevertalent.com labels some rows by rank (e.g. Revive Rank 5, Lacerate Rank 5); rank 1 IDs of Revive and Lacerate return nothing on the tooltip API, so the lowest rank found is used.
Insect Swarm is row 4 (level 25) on wowforevertalent.com, but its Forever tooltip says level 20 (row 3). The table uses the row from wowforevertalent.com.
gaps: Treants and Force of Nature are not covered (pets).
Faerie Fire (Feral) does not exist on the tooltip API in the Classic ID; if Forever has a Cat/Bear version it is not found.
Passive abilities: Poised, Feline Grace, Moonkin Aura, Leader of the Pack, Eclipse and the other passive talents.
Lacerate rank 1-2 and Revive rank 1 IDs, so their entries show a later rank.
Every rank after the first and the level it is trained at.
